title: Lockage
summary: LOCK'AGE, noun 1. Materials for locks in a canal. 2. Works which form a lock on a canal. 3. Toll paid for passing the locks of a canal.

inlines.v: LOCK'AGE, noun 1. Materials for locks in a canal. 2. Works which form a lock on a canal. 3. Toll paid for passing the locks of a canal.
